name: Culhwch ac Olwen

attributes.attribute: a Welsh tale named for two figures

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Culhwch ac Olwen is the title of a Welsh tale. The source sends the reader onward to the separate accounts of the prince Culhwch and the maiden Olwen.

okr.objective: Culhwch ac Olwen is a Welsh story answered by the accounts of two figures.
key_results: It draws its name from the prince and the maiden.
The source offers the pair their separate accounts.
The tale is a centerpiece of the Welsh Arthurian storytelling.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
